Charging: Qualcomm QC 2 is native to all Samsung up to and including S10 Plus. The same 5-9 volt 18 watt charger that Samsung has used for years is included. Both Note9 and S10 Plus also support optional USB C-PD charging. It is not clear if either can support charging 24 watt charging. Using a C-PD charger does not reduce total charging time significantly. When buying a portable battery there is no need to pay more for a power delivery portable battery with a C port. A $20 slim battery with Type A certified QC 3 port works as well and as fast as any. The original cable and compact Samsung wall charger are all that is required.
